newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: NORTH BORNEO IN CHIP MILL VENTURE.
newsitem.headline: NORTH BORNEO IN CHIP MILL VENTURE.

text.p: Malaysia's North Borneo Timbers Bhd (NBT) said on Monday it would set up a chip mill in the eastern state of Sabah on Borneo island.
NBT and Begeraya Sdn Bhd would establish a joint venture company known as Bentapuri Sdn Bhd for the purpose. NBT would own 60 percent, while Begeraya would hold the rest, said NBT.

In return for the 40 percent stake in Bentapuri, Begaraya will assign its rights to log plantation trees from the Sabah Forestry Development Authority's area and to plant fast-growing trees, said NBT.
The area of the plantation land covers 90,000 acres (36,450 hectares), said NBT.
Shares of NBT were suspended on August 7, and were last traded at 37.50 ringgit.
